craft_notes: Sthāyin: debate method — wed then wreck. Rows: sate, tell, method, bound. Rejected: partisanship — killed: join-then-refute both ways. Read aloud: fencing rhythm.

lines: Then sate the wheel with the common bowl-rite, then tell —
thread, sentence, chapter, unclashed fore and aft —
first wed the thesis fairly, then fairly wreck it;
prove the point, bare the drift — tell to the chapter's bound, no more;
there too, at each joint's close, sating and praise — till the telling ends.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sāmānyārghapātrayogena cakraṃ tarpayet tato vyācakṣīta sūtravākyapaṭalagrantham pūrvāparāviruddhaṃ kurvan tantrāvṛttiprasaṅgasamuccayavikalpādiśāstranyāyaucityena pūrvaṃ pakṣaṃ samyak ghaṭayitvā samyak ca dūṣayan sādhyaṃ sādhayan tātparyavṛttiṃ pradarśayan paṭalāntaṃ vyācakṣīta nādhikam tatrāpi vastvante vastvante tarpaṇaṃ pūjanam iti yāvad vyākhyāsamāptiḥ
